mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT t.device_id AS d FROM logan_task t WHERE 1=1
UNION SELECT p.device_id AS d FROM logan_device_poll p WHERE 1=1
UNION SELECT c.device_id AS d FROM logan_crash c WHERE 1=1
UNION SELECT h.device_id AS d FROM logan_http h WHERE 1=1
) u WHERE u.d IS NOT NULL AND u.d <> ''

SELECT c.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id) AS devices, COUNT(DISTINCT c.fingerprint) AS issues FROM logan_crash c WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY c.kind ORDER BY events DESC

SELECT
(c.crash_time + #{q.tzOffsetMs}) DIV 3600000 * 3600000 - #{q.tzOffsetMs} AS bucketTime
(c.crash_time + #{q.tzOffsetMs}) DIV 86400000 * 86400000 - #{q.tzOffsetMs} AS bucketTime
, c.kind AS kind, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id) AS devices FROM logan_crash c WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY bucketTime, c.kind ORDER BY bucketTime

SELECT i.id AS issueId, i.app_id AS appId, i.platform AS platform, i.kind AS kind, i.fingerprint AS fingerprint, i.signal_info AS signalInfo, i.top_frames AS topFrames, i.llm_summary AS llmSummary, i.llm_severity AS llmSeverity, i.status AS status, i.reopen_count AS reopenCount, i.first_crash_time AS firstCrashTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_crash c WHERE c.app_id = i.app_id AND c.fingerprint = i.fingerprint AND c.app_id=#{q.appId} AND c.platform=#{q.platform} AND c.app_version=#{q.appVersion} AND c.crash_time BETWEEN #{q.beginTime} AND #{q.endTime}) AS windowEvents, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id) FROM logan_crash c WHERE c.app_id = i.app_id AND c.fingerprint = i.fingerprint AND c.app_id=#{q.appId} AND c.platform=#{q.platform} AND c.app_version=#{q.appVersion} AND c.crash_time BETWEEN #{q.beginTime} AND #{q.endTime}) AS windowDevices, (SELECT MAX(c.crash_time) FROM logan_crash c WHERE c.app_id = i.app_id AND c.fingerprint = i.fingerprint AND c.crash_time BETWEEN #{q.beginTime} AND #{q.endTime}) AS lastWindowTime FROM logan_crash_issue i WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM logan_crash c2 WHERE c2.app_id = i.app_id AND c2.fingerprint = i.fingerprint AND c2.app_id=#{q.appId} AND c2.platform=#{q.platform} AND c2.app_version=#{q.appVersion} AND c2.crash_time BETWEEN #{q.beginTime} AND #{q.endTime}) AND i.status = #{q.status} ORDER BY windowEvents DESC, windowDevices DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT
CONCAT(c.platform, ':', IFNULL(c.release_ver, '')) AS groupKey, CONCAT(CASE c.platform WHEN 1 THEN 'Android ' WHEN 2 THEN 'iOS ' WHEN 3 THEN 'HarmonyOS ' ELSE 'other ' END, IFNULL(c.release_ver, '-')) AS label, IFNULL(c.release_ver, '') AS value
CONCAT(IFNULL(c.app_version, ''), '/', IFNULL(c.build_version, '')) AS groupKey, CONCAT(IFNULL(c.app_version, '-'), '(', IFNULL(c.build_version, '-'), ')') AS label, IFNULL(c.app_version, '') AS value
CONCAT(IFNULL(c.brand, ''), '|', IFNULL(c.model, '')) AS groupKey, CONCAT_WS(' ', NULLIF(c.brand, ''), NULLIF(c.model, '')) AS label, IFNULL(c.brand, '') AS value
, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT c.device_id) AS devices , MIN(c.crash_time) AS firstTime, MAX(c.crash_time) AS lastTime FROM logan_crash c WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY groupKey, label, value HAVING label IS NOT NULL AND label <> '' AND value IS NOT NULL AND value <> '' AND groupKey NOT LIKE '%:' ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT #{limit}
